title: Ledgerline Server 4.2.0 release notes

headings.text: Step 1: Back up and stop the service

key_sentences: Ledgerline Server 4.2.0 introduces scheduled reconciliation, faster ledger exports and stricter TLS defaults.
Most installations can upgrade in place in under fifteen minutes, but one configuration key has been renamed.
The server refuses to start if the old key reconcile_every is still present in the configuration file.
Clients that only support TLS 1.2 will fail to connect after the upgrade unless tls_min_version is set back to "1.2".
The migration adds two indexes to the journal table and takes about one minute per ten million journal lines.
If the health check fails, stop the service, reinstall version 4.1.3 and restore the backup taken in step 1.

rows: Parquet export format for ledgers and journals
Streaming writer for exports; memory use no longer grows with ledger size
Rounding error in multi-currency balances with more than four decimals
Health endpoint reported ready before migrations had finished
Configuration key reconcile_every renamed to reconcile_interval
The XML export endpoint will be removed in 5.0
Run ledgerctl migrate --apply twice; the first run upgrades to the 4.1 schema.

list_items.text: Reconciliation jobs can now run on a fixed interval instead of only on demand.
CSV and Parquet exports of large ledgers are about three times faster.
TLS 1.3 is the default minimum version for the HTTP listener.
The audit log records the client certificate fingerprint for every write.

code:
$ ledgerctl backup create --label pre-4.2 --verify
$ sudo systemctl stop ledgerline
$ sudo apt-get install ledgerline-server=4.2.0-1

# /etc/ledgerline/server.yaml
database:
  url: postgres://ledger@db01:5432/ledger
  pool_size: 20
http:
  listen: 0.0.0.0:8443
  tls_min_version: "1.3"
jobs:
  reconcile_interval: 15m   # was reconcile_every in 4.1

$ ledgerctl migrate --check
$ ledgerctl migrate --apply
$ sudo systemctl start ledgerline
$ curl -fsS https://localhost:8443/healthz
{"status":"ready","version":"4.2.0"}
